map.evidence: board.jpg and battle.jpg minimap show the four-loop clover route with a centre cell; only DMP 0172 (104 cells) has that shape among the 26 source maps

method: OpenCV TM_CCOEFF_NORMED with the native 145x97 TIS alpha mask (alpha>200), sprite rows reversed (the PNG export is stored bottom-up), scale 1:1. 'global' = best match over the whole 800x600 capture; 'local' = best match within +-60 px of the hex formula prediction. tools/brd01_measure_board_jpg.py reproduces every number. On 2026-11-21 the original JPEG luminance and original bottom-up RGBA tile luminance were decoded independently; integer translation search ±45 pixels around the prior anchor prediction, Pearson correlation over even x/y source pixels with alpha>200 and source-space masks excluding the visible duel overlay. Each selected local maximum independently landed at the stated center; alternativeScore is the best candidate more than 4 pixels from that maximum. Python tool reproduces these five masked peaks. Scores may differ slightly by JPEG IDCT decoder.
